title: Fix the Sum of Numbers
description: The program should calculate the sum of numbers from 1 to 5 (inclusive). Fix the bug.
buggyCode:
total = 0
for i in range(1, 5):
    total += i
print(total)
expectedBehavior: The program should print 15, the sum of 1+2+3+4+5.
actualProblem: range(1, 5) stops before 5, producing only 1, 2, 3, 4, so the loop never adds 5 and the total is 10 instead of 15.
correctedCode:
total = 0
for i in range(1, 6):
    total += i
print(total)
explanation: range(start, stop) never includes stop itself. To include 5 in the loop, the stop argument must be one greater than the last desired value, i.e. range(1, 6).
